Overview

ARTPARK Open Day is a monthly program that opens the doors of ARTGarage to anyone curious about what we build and how we build it. Each month features two dedicated sessions, one for the community and one for VCs and corporates.

The Facility

Where Innovators Become Founders

ARTGarage is a unique deep-tech facility, 75,000 sq ft of advanced manufacturing equipment, clean rooms, communications infrastructure, GPU compute, and indoor-outdoor testing arenas, all in one place.

Here, innovators move from concept to prototype to customer trial at a pace that saves precious months, if not years.

Operated by

Backed By

Technology Areas
Advanced Manufacturing

Robotics, automation, and AI-driven production systems for India's industrial base.

HealthTech

Diagnostics AI, surgical robotics, and clinical decision infrastructure for population-scale healthcare.

Aerospace & Defence

Autonomous systems, surveillance robotics, and next-generation propulsion technologies.

SpaceTech

Satellite systems, earth observation, and in-space propulsion for India's commercial space economy.

What's Inside

6 Specialised Labs and Facilities
01
Networked Robotic Test Facility

Indoor and outdoor arenas for testing ground robots, drones, and underwater systems in realistic conditions. Multi-robot coordination, obstacle courses, and sensor calibration environments.

02
Advanced Manufacturing & Fabrication

CNC machining, 3D printing (FDM, SLA, SLS), metal fabrication, PCB assembly, and clean rooms. Everything needed to go from CAD to working prototype in days, not months.

03
04
Autonomous Vehicle Test Facility

Dedicated test track for autonomous ground vehicles and drone corridors — including simulated urban environments, rough terrain sections, and sensor-validation zones.

Bharat 5G Lab & CoE-WWT

A live 5G testbed with hybrid 5G-Wi-Fi network, Li-Fi, and millimeter-wave systems. Used by startups, researchers, and industry partners to validate 5G-enabled autonomous systems and IoT applications.

05
GPU Compute Cluster

On-site high-performance compute for AI model training, simulation, and digital twin development. Accessible to ARTPARK startups, fellows, and research teams.

06
Agri Robotics Centre of Excellence

Dedicated zone for developing and testing agricultural robots and precision farming systems. Simulated crop environments, soil testing stations, and drone-based field monitoring setups.
